annotations.title: Set margin and cost per order for profit

description: The numbers campaign_profit turns revenue into profit with: marginPercent (0-100, the share of revenue kept as gross profit; null removes profit), costPerOrder (subtracted per sale, in each ad account’s currency) and campaignMargins, a margin per campaign {"<campaign id, utm_campaign or name>": percent} (null removes one). profit = revenue × margin − sales × costPerOrder; POAS = profit ÷ spend; profit after ads = profit − spend. A campaign whose results upload carries cogs or gross_profit uses those instead. No arguments reads the setting. Free.

campaignMargins.description: per-campaign margins; null for one removes it

costPerOrder.description: per sale, in each ad account’s currency

name: set_profit_settings
